{{Quote|Soldiers are expendable tools for politicians like her, who don't like to muddy or bloody their hands with the defense of the Republic. Yet it was soldiers who liberated her world a decade ago, and now she's calling us cowards.|Laslo Dorits referring to Senator Padmé Amidala|<ref name="HNN" />}}
'''Laslo Dorits''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] spokesbeing for the [[Stark Veteran Assembly]]. While as a guest on the talk show ''[[Essence]]'' in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], he criticized statements made by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] during her campaign against the militarization of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After Dorits said Amidala's statements were stupid and typical, the senator left a non-directed message in support of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] but against warmongering via the [[Naboo message exchange]] on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].

==Biography==
[[File:PadmeAmidala-NEGTC.png|thumb|right|250px|Laslo Dorits called the statements of Senator Amidala (pictured) disgraceful, stupid, and typical.]]
Laslo Dorits was the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-aligned [[Human/Legends|Human]] spokesbeing for the [[Stark Veteran Assembly]]<ref name="HNN" /> in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_4.html|Stark Veterans Blast Amidala}} is set on the date 13:2:28, which corresponds to [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> The group was associated with the veterans of the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]],<ref name="HNN" /> a conflict between the Republic and the [[Stark Commercial Combine]]<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that took place in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="StarkDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]] dates the events of the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]] to [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].''</ref> In 23 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Dorits was a guest on the talk show ''[[Essence]]'', hosted by the [[Troig/Legends|Troig]] individual [[AndroosinLiann]] and based on<ref name="HNN" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="HNN" />

During the live interview,<ref name="HNN" /> he<ref name="CSWE" /> described the statements of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]&mdash;made during a [[Campaign against Republic Militarization|campaign]] against the militarization of the Republic&mdash;as disgraceful, stupid, and typical. He additionally told AndroosinLiann that [[Politics/Legends|politicians]] like Amidala saw [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] as expendable tools, and that she called them cowards despite them liberating her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="HNN" /> the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="NEC" /> Amidala declined to comment on the statements but posted a statement on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet's]] [[Naboo message exchange]], where she stated her respect for soldiers tasked to protect their homes, but did not approve of warmongering in the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].<ref name="HNN" /> Reporting out of<ref name="HNN" /> the [[City/Legends|city]]<ref name="GATORW" /> [[Phelar/Legends|Phelar]] on Eridau, an article on the statements was included in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531|Vol. 531]] of [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|HoloNet News CoCo District Editon]] on the [[Great ReSynchronization calendar|date]] 13:2:28.<ref name="HNN" />

==Personality and traits==
Dorits had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and light skin. He criticized Amidala for statements made in her campaign against the militarization of the Republic, and felt politicians did not like to get their hands dirty in the defense of the Republic.<ref name="HNN" />

==Equipment==
The spokesbeing wore, while as a guest on ''Esssence'', a decorated blue [[Clothing/Legends|suit top]] and a [[Sash/Legends|sash]] featuring the emblem of the Galactic Republic.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Laslo Dorits was first mentioned in "Stark Veterans Blast Amidala," an article in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 45|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #45]], published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]].<ref name="HNN" /> Written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]],<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> the article was posted on [[February 28]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN45 date">Per {{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220914072556/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-4#post-6042498}}, [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47|''HoloNet News Vol. 531'' #47]] was released on [[March 14]], [[2002]]. As [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] segments were published weekly, and {{Hnn|45||A Closer Look}} was published two issues prior, it must have been released on [[February 28]] of the same year.</ref>
